command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# No PATH export: aarchsci env images already have their python first (unlike aarchbio).

echo "== staged bytes must match their pin =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: identities.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

# Pass 1, DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: which GL backends exist with no display at all. This records
# the env's capability and must never fail the task -- see the README on why that is not
# an assertion.
echo "== backends available with no DISPLAY (diagnostic) =="
unset DISPLAY
python3 -u identities.py --backends 2>&1 | tee backends.txt

# Pass 2, the real checks: software GL needs an X server in this image.
echo "== rendering under Xvfb =="
Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 >/tmp/xvfb.log 2>&1 &
XVFB_PID=$!
sleep 3
export DISPLAY=:99
python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee identities.log
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
kill "$XVFB_PID" 2>/dev/null
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
